summary.name: Viz.ai
summary.one_liner: Viz.ai is an AI-powered care coordination platform that analyzes medical imaging to flag suspected diseases and speed up diagnosis and treatment.
use_cases: Detecting suspected diseases from CT scans and other imaging
Speeding up time to diagnosis and treatment
Coordinating care between patients and clinicians
summary.what_it_does: The platform uses more than 50 FDA-cleared AI algorithms that analyze medical imaging data such as CT scans, EKGs, and echocardiograms. It provides real-time insights and automated assessments intended to accelerate diagnosis and support treatment decisions. Its flagship product, Viz.ai One, is described as an all-in-one solution that autodetects suspected diseases across a range of therapeutic areas. The page says it aims to save clinician time and improve patient and economic outcomes, but gives no technical detail on how the algorithms work.
notable: Covers CT, EKG and echocardiogram data
caveats: Pricing is not listed on the page; access is via a demo request (listing marks it as paid)
Platforms beyond the website are not named on the page
